observation: Four feature cards: ecosystem says1000+packages/10,000+users; cross-platform says Linux/macOS/Windows support ROS2. Counts course-specific not current census; no guarantee every package or driver works everywhere.

Six cards include Production Ready: mature reliability for commercial and industrial deployment; Security: encrypted communications/authenticated participants; Embedded resource-limited hardware; Multi-robot coordination; Vendor Neutral standard DDS with certified middleware; realtime conditional capability, not universal guarantee.
Course Jetson host handles AI/vision GPU assistance and middleware; simple Arduino-like microcontroller moves motors. Scope is pictured course system, not universal architecture requirement.
Actual five nodes and four UNARROWED edges: Camera-Lidar, Lidar-Control, Camera-SLAM, Lidar-Nav. No SLAM-Nav edge, camera-control edge, topic labels or publication direction.
Within Jetson graphic explicitly labels Vision Node GPU and Planning Node CPU; separate-process crash isolation is conditional example, not global promise every node is a separate process.

Package contains source/config/data for functionality; worker/workplace analogy. Diagram three packages with arrows to their respective camera/detection/motor nodes. Main guard behavior is Python execution question on187, not added package semantics.
Directed chain Camera → /camera/raw → AI Detection → /detected_objects → Navigation → /cmd_vel → Drive. This is not unarrowed five-node drawing183.
Python code MyNode subclass defines main with init, instance,spin,shutdown; final if __name__==__main__ calls main only for direct execution. Definition alone does not execute function body.
